### Sugar Apple (G4)

**Who she is:** A blink-and-you-miss-her **Cloudsdale pegasus** in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Look for the pale periwinkle coat, vivid magenta mane and tail, pink eyes, and tiny red-blue-yellow **rainbow cutie mark** at the weather factory in **“Sonic Rainboom” (season 1, episode 16, around 12:15)**. She is a background mare, not Sugar Belle or an established Apple-family relative. No spoken line, voice actor, later show/comic appearance, or alternate persona could be verified.

**Names and continuity:** **“Sugar Apple” is a fan/reference-list identification**, not a verified name spoken in the episode or supplied by a G4 credit. Some fandom lists also call her **“Starsong”** because she resembles the *G3* pony Starsong; resemblance is not proof they are the same character. The [G1 Sugar Apple](https://mylittlewiki.org/wiki/Sugar_Apple)—a blue Candy Cane Pony with striped pink-and-white hair—is a separate earlier toy character. A [2012 roleplay profile by Bellosh](https://www.canterlot.com/topic/11968-tier-3-sugar-apple-finished/) invents an Apple-family/weather-factory backstory and pink-apple mark; those details belong to that fan-created roleplay continuity, **not** the television episode.
